    my_role: "decide: I moderate under the charter and report records misuse under para 6"
    values: [duty_to_individual, institutional_credibility, oversight_candor, usp_privacy]

  fit:
    case: REL-301
    rating: poor
    why: "REL-301 is a foreign disclosure under a delegation letter. Mine is an officer's post in a chat I moderate: a different question, different values, a different decider."

  compare:

      live: "no foreign disclosure request: nothing classified, no DDL, category or delegation letter"
      here: missing
      matters: "no"
      why: "Its authority test has no counterpart here."
    - ref: c2
      live: "no disclosure criteria or security survey"
      here: missing
      matters: "no"
      why: "The criteria have nothing to attach to."
    - ref: c3
      live: "no conference date or referral queue"
      here: missing
      matters: "no"
      why: "No deadline pulls here."
    - ref: c4
      live: "no first disclosure to a government"
      here: missing
      matters: "no"
      why: "Nothing turns on a first disclosure."
    - ref: c5
      live: "Reyna's marriage is now gossip in front of 14 officers and cannot be unsaid"
      here: weaker
      matters: "no"
      why: "It cannot be unsaid, but it was hearsay, not a disclosure I could approve."

  new:
    - live: "the poster is the combat systems officer, with no access to records, repeating mess-decks hearsay once"
      favors: []
      value: oversight_candor
      matters: decides
      why: "No record was misused, so para 6 is not engaged."
    - live: "the post mocks a sailor's marriage where he cannot answer, and it is still up"
      favors: []
      value: duty_to_individual
      matters: decides
      why: "It should come down, so closing the flag alone is not enough."
    - live: "the charter: keep it civil; what is said in the wardroom stays there"
      favors: []
      value: institutional_credibility
      matters: weighs
      why: "A private word to the poster does both."
    - live: "nothing on record shows Marsh has done this before"
      favors: []
      value: due_process
      matters: weighs
      why: "A first lapse suits a private word."

  carry:
    relation: not_governed
    settled: "Nothing: REL-301 governs foreign disclosure under a delegation letter, and none is in play."
    open: "Everything, from the CO's instructions and the charter: no record was misused, so para 6 is not engaged, but the post still exposes Reyna. I ask Marsh privately to delete it and close the flag."

  decide:
    course: "Ask LTJG Marsh privately to delete the post, close F-3318 with what was done, and log it."
    confidence: 0.8
    now: "Message Marsh: which post, why it should come down, delete it tonight; close F-3318 with that disposition; log it."
    would_change_my_mind: "The details came from a personnel record or someone who keeps them: that is records misuse, and I report it to the CO with the excerpt."

arguments.text: LTJG Marsh, the admin assistant here, as #wardroom moderator. Your 2139 post repeats mess-decks talk about EN2 Reyna's marriage. He isn't in the chat to answer it, and the charter asks us to keep it civil. Please delete it tonight. Nothing further from me.

arguments.disposition: One post (m5521) repeating hearsay about a non-member's marriage; no personnel record involved. Asked the poster privately to delete it.
